levers.untimed_counts: M4 held-out train sweeps (recall@10 vs ef, 2000 queries): baseline 4-bit per-row glove 0.90 at ef 256, 0.95 at ef 768; nytimes 0.90 at ef 96, 0.95 at ef 384 (writerslogic-02 untimed A). 1-bit direct blocks: glove 0.90 at ef 768, nytimes 0.90 at ef 256, 0.95 not reached by ef 768. 1-bit residual blocks (SymphonyQG form): glove 0.908 at ef 768, nytimes 0.900 at ef 384: no gain, residual and query-to-vertex norms are near 1 on these sets. Residual + fusion: glove 0.898 at ef 512, 0.9225 at ef 768 (+0.015 to +0.028).

levers.decision: proceed with 2-bit residual blocks + fusion + certified stop (stop_z) as the candidate; 1-bit kept as the bytes-light variant; 4-bit blocks killed by the 25% rule on both hosts

levers.physical_bound_note: with 4-bit code + 4-bit residual (100 B) + per-vertex scales and id map (12 B) + adjacency (>= 64 B at degree 32 even at 2 B per id) the floor is about 176 B/vector = 1.04x RaBitQ IVF; the 0.9x target needs a smaller degree or a shared-code layout, recorded here as the measured bound, not met
